training_data.name: Mental Health Counseling Conversations
training_data.quote: The model was trained on the Mental Health Counseling Conversations dataset, which contains: Size: 3,500 conversation pairs; Format: Context (user query) and Response (counselor advice); Domain: Mental health support and counseling; Language: English.

training_method.objective_quote: Training Approach: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with response-only masking

description.text:
This is a fully merged model (base model + LoRA adapters) fine-tuned on the Mental Health Counseling Conversations dataset.

This model has been fine-tuned to provide empathetic and helpful responses to mental health-related queries. It's designed to offer supportive guidance while maintaining professional boundaries appropriate for AI-assisted mental health support.

use_claim.quote: This model has been fine-tuned to provide empathetic and helpful responses to mental health-related queries. It's designed to offer supportive guidance while maintaining professional boundaries appropriate for AI-assisted mental health support.

warning.quote: Always seek professional help for mental health concerns.

serving.text_only_input_quote: "type": "text", "text": "I've been feeling anxious lately. What can I do?"
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets token ids only. The sampling values above are the card's inference example. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the Gemma 3 template is in chat_template.jinja and on the model API. It does not define a system prompt (use_default_system_prompt is false). If the caller supplies a system message, the template prefixes it onto the first user turn. config.json is Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration with a SigLIP vision tower and max_position_embeddings 131072. The training notebook sets finetune_vision_layers = False and comments "Text-only model", and caps training sequences at 2048. Released weights are BF16; the card says the merged file is float16. The notebook saves with save_method merged_16bit.

evaluation_reported.text: The card logs training and validation loss every 50 steps through step 550. Final validation loss: 1.9974. It also says: Quantitative evaluation metrics for mental health counseling quality are complex and context-dependent. This model should be evaluated in controlled settings with professional oversight.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are lora|sft. The card says LoRA and supervised fine-tuning. The training notebook loads unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it with load_in_4bit = True and then adds LoRA, which is QLoRA, and trains with SFTTrainer. The card YAML and the notebook name the parent unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it. The GitHub README links the base to google/gemma-3-4b-it. The dataset id matches.
